issuer_cash_vs_in_kind.key_finding: For Bitwise, Q3 net cash share capital was about $89.392M while in-kind XRP creations were about $82.738M. For Franklin, Q3 cash XRP purchases were about $35.793M and in-kind XRP contributions about $54.858M, with no redemptions shown. The XRP holdings increase therefore overstates cash-only demand if treated as new cash investment. This is a concrete accounting distinction relevant to the exact-phrase research around 'actual capital', but it does not resolve the phrase's identity or context.

repository_architecture_review.xrp_ingestion_workflow: Designed on integration branch; scheduled hourly and daily, but the schedule is not active on main until merge. Integration push/manual capture is read-only and artifact-based.

repository_architecture_review.feature_store: SQLite point-in-time store with canonical manifests and trigger-based update/delete deterrence. Its own documentation correctly states this is not adversarially tamper-proof; external signed/checkpointed or independently controlled immutable retention remains needed.
repository_architecture_review.forecast_ledger: Fixed-horizon forecast ledger with readiness policy and evaluator attestation. No directional forecast is authorized by this snapshot.
repository_architecture_review.prediction_evaluation: Chronological walk-forward, baseline, calibration and drift modules exist on integration; actual out-of-sample lift and calibration sufficient for publication have not been established.
repository_architecture_review.raw_retention: GitHub Actions artifacts and cache checkpoints are not WORM storage; retention continuity is checked but independent immutable retention is not verified.
repository_architecture_review.nine_platforms: Capability/authentication/permission/data-flow map exists; no live nine-platform authentication and data-flow test was performed in this run.
